demo.title: Cash out Base USDC with Fast or Best
demo.code:
Ask your agent: "Estimate how many EUR I would receive for 100 USDC through Revolut, then prepare a Fast cash-out to my revtag."

The agent discovers the live catalog, labels the estimate approximate, and shows the exact Fast or Best preview. It submits only after a later-turn confirmation.

setup: Run `npm install` inside the installed skill directory
Set a Bankr API key with Wallet API write access as `BANKR_API_KEY`; never share a private key
Keep a small Base ETH balance for gas and Base USDC for the cash-out
Every write requires a deterministic preview followed by explicit confirmation in a later turn
Choose mode explicitly: Fast (0% spread) or Best (Delegate, 10 bps)
